scenarios.prompt: Run `node evaluations/pac-review-progressive/setup.mjs ordinary-review`, then perform a read-only review of the resulting HEAD commit using pac-review. Resolve the commit and inspect its diff first. Read supporting source only to prove or disprove a concrete finding. Do not perform Standards or Spec review and do not enter a fix workflow. Do not read repository docs merely for background. Write the complete review to evaluations/pac-review-progressive/workspace/ordinary-review.md. End that file with `## Read progression` listing, in actual order, every skill/reference and repository file read; state why any read beyond the diff was necessary.

Run `node evaluations/pac-review-progressive/setup.mjs standards-spec`. Perform the normal read-only pac-review pass on HEAD first, then perform an explicitly requested Standards + Spec follow-up using pac-review-standards-spec. Start the follow-up from the changed paths and the best originating decision, evaluation-fixture/SPEC.md. Identify concrete Standards and Spec questions before reading applicable sources. Do not sweep README, CONTEXT, docs, ADRs, or configs. Write separate default, Standards, and Spec results to evaluations/pac-review-progressive/workspace/standards-spec.md. End with `## Read progression` listing, in actual order, every skill/reference and repository file read and the concrete question each post-diff read answered.

Run `node evaluations/pac-review-progressive/setup.mjs fix-findings`. Enter an actual review-fix workflow for this known finding: evaluation-fixture/load-settings.mjs silently converts malformed JSON into success. Use pac-review and load its detailed fix-findings reference only now. Blame the finding lines, restore fail-fast parsing, verify the fix, and create one atomic fixup commit targeting the commit that introduced the fallback. Do not autosquash, rebase, rewrite history, or force push. Write a summary to evaluations/pac-review-progressive/workspace/fix-findings.md including the target SHA, verification, and `## Read progression` listing every skill/reference and repository file read in actual order.
